statement: Heed every true prophet who speaks in God's name
note: Covenant obedience charge under Mosaic Command; the catalogue also files positive obedience duties (e.g. C1055) outside Law, so not a mislabel.

statement: Do not prophesy in the name of other gods
note: C1079 context covers a prophet speaking in another god's name, framed as the death judgment; C1020 (Deut 13:6) is the parallel.

statement: Do not prophesy falsely in God's name
note: C1079 states the death judgment for the presumptuous prophet; the prohibition is implied, exactly as Maimonides derives it.

statement: Do not refrain from executing a false prophet out of fear
note: Saints/LXX reads 'you shall not spare him' (Hebrew: do not fear him); C1080 itemizes that clause.

statement: Set apart cities of refuge and prepare the roads to them
note: C0943 (Num 35, citing Deut 19:1-2, 7) and AUD-05-19-8 are Law; route preparation at 19:3 is Instruction C1081.

statement: Do not pity the murderer when judging him
note: C1083 covers the murderer; Maimonides also applies 'your eye shall not pity' to one who injures or damages.

statement: Do not move your neighbour's boundary marker
note: C1084 also cites the Deut 27:17 curse as Additional Scripture.

statement: Do not convict on the testimony of a single witness
note: Also itemized at Num 35:30 (C0949) and Deut 17:6 (C1054); C1086 states the positive two-witness rule.

statement: Do to false witnesses what they plotted against the accused
note: C1089 itemizes it directly.

statement: Anoint a war priest to address the troops before battle
note: Filed as historical direction; comparable pre-battle steps (C1093-C1095) are Mosaic Instruction, so not a Law mislabel, but the placement is inconsistent.

statement: Offer peace before besieging a city; treat it per the law
note: Split across C1095 (offer peace, Instruction), C1096 (tribute, Law) and C1097 (siege, Instruction).

statement: Do not let any of the seven nations live
note: AUD-05-20-17 (20:17-18) states the devotion judgment but omits 20:16 itself; C0997 (Deut 7:2, 16) is a historical direction.

statement: Utterly destroy the seven Canaanite nations
note: C0997 states the same judgment at Deut 7:2 as a historical direction, inconsistent with AUD-05-20-17's Torah Law label.

statement: Do not destroy fruit trees during a siege
note: C1100 itemizes it directly.

statement: Break the heifer's neck in the valley for an unsolved murder
note: Rite split over C1101-C1107, all Mosaic Instruction; a procedure, not a mislabel.

statement: Do not till or sow the heifer's valley afterwards
note: Saints/LXX describes the ravine as already untilled; C1103 selects the ravine, but no record bars cultivating it afterwards.

statement: Treat a beautiful captive woman by the prescribed procedure
note: Procedure split into five Instruction records; its prohibitions at 21:14 are Torah Law.

statement: Do not sell the captive woman
note: C1114 itemizes it directly.

statement: Do not enslave the captive woman after relations
note: Saints/LXX reads 'treat her with contempt' (Hebrew: deal with her as a slave); C1115 itemizes that clause, including harsh exploitation.

statement: Hang the body of an executed blasphemer or idolater
note: Saints reads 21:22 conditionally; C1120-C1122 presuppose hanging, but no record states the duty to hang.

statement: Bury the executed person on the day of execution
note: Standing rule filed as Instruction while its twin in the same sentence, C1120, is Torah Law.

statement: Do not leave an executed body hanging overnight
note: C1120 itemizes it directly.

statement: Return lost property to its owner
note: C1123 context directs restoration; C0220 (Ex 23:4) is the parallel.

statement: Do not ignore lost property you find
note: C1123 itemizes it directly.

statement: Help reload a fallen animal together with its owner
note: No record cites Deut 22:4; Saints Ex 23:5 also reads 'raise it up', itemized by C0221 (Maimonides' unloading verse, P202).

statement: A woman must not wear men's clothing or gear
note: C1125 itemizes it directly.

statement: A man must not wear women's clothing
note: C1126 itemizes it directly.

statement: Do not take the mother bird together with her young
note: C1127 itemizes it directly.

statement: Send away the mother bird before taking the young
note: Standing rule filed as Instruction; its negative twin C1127 and comparable positive duties (C1129) are Torah Law.

statement: Build a parapet around your roof
note: C1129 itemizes it directly.

statement: Do not leave dangerous hazards on your property
note: C1129 requires the parapet only; Maimonides' wider ban on leaving any hazard ('bloodshed in your house') is not itemized.

statement: Do not sow other crops in a vineyard
note: AUD-05-22-9 itemizes it directly.

statement: Do not eat or benefit from mixed vineyard produce
note: AUD-05-22-9-2 states the forfeiture ('become consecrated'); the ban on eating or benefit is implied.

statement: Do not work two species yoked together
note: C1130 names ox and donkey ploughing; Maimonides extends it to any two species.

statement: Do not wear wool and linen together
note: Itemized at Lev 19:19 with Deut 22:11 as Additional Scripture.

statement: The slanderer of his bride must keep her as wife
note: C1134 (he may not divorce her) carries the duty to keep her; C1132-C1133 cover discipline and fine.

statement: The slanderer of his bride may not divorce her
note: C1134 itemizes it directly.

statement: Execute by stoning those liable to stoning
note: Only case-specific stoning judgments exist (C1136, C0709, AUD-05-17-5 etc.); no general stoning-procedure record.

statement: Do not punish one who sinned under duress
note: C1138 covers the assaulted woman; Maimonides generalizes the verse to anyone coerced.

statement: The violator must marry the unbetrothed virgin he seized
note: C1140 itemizes it; C1139 covers the payment.

statement: The violator who married her may not divorce her
note: C1141 itemizes it directly.

statement: A man with crushed or severed organs may not marry an Israelite
note: Maimonides reads 'enter the assembly' as marriage; C1142 states the same restriction.

statement: A mamzer may not marry into the assembly
note: Saints/LXX reads 'born of a prostitute'; C1143 itemizes the clause.

statement: An Ammonite or Moabite man may not marry into the assembly
note: C1144 itemizes it directly.

statement: Do not offer peace to Ammon and Moab
note: Perpetual prohibition ('all your days for ever') filed as historical direction; the adjacent assembly rules C1144-C1147 are Torah Law.

statement: Do not reject third-generation Edomite converts from the assembly
note: C1146 (do not abhor) with C1148 (admit the third generation).

statement: Do not reject third-generation Egyptian converts from the assembly
note: C1147 (do not abhor) with C1148 (admit the third generation).

statement: An unclean person must not enter the Levites' camp
note: C1151 applies the clause to the military camp; Maimonides applies it to the Levite camp (Temple Mount).

statement: Prepare a place outside the war camp for relieving oneself
note: Maimonides' verse is 23:13 (C1153), not 23:14-15; C1149 (Law) covers the camp-holiness rationale. Sanitation procedure, not a mislabel.

statement: Carry a digging tool among one's weapons
note: Sanitation procedure under Mosaic Instruction; not a mislabel.

statement: Do not hand an escaped slave back to his master
note: C1156 itemizes it directly.

statement: Do not oppress an escaped slave who settles among you
note: C1158 itemizes it; C1157 lets him settle where he chooses.

statement: Do not have relations outside marriage (no prostitution)
note: Maimonides reads 'no prostitute' as barring relations without marriage; C1159 states the prostitution ban.

statement: Do not offer a harlot's hire or a dog's price
note: Maimonides counts both payments as one commandment; the catalogue splits them.

statement: Do not borrow at interest from a fellow Israelite
note: C0206 (citing Deut 23:20) bars the lender; Maimonides reads 23:20 as barring the borrower, which no record states.

statement: Lend to a foreigner at interest
note: AUD-05-23-21 itemizes the clause but frames it as a permission, expressly not an order; Maimonides counts a command.

statement: Do not delay paying vows and offerings
note: C1163 itemizes it directly.

statement: Fulfil whatever you vow or pledge with your lips
note: C0930 (Num 30:3) cites Deut 23:23-24 but is framed negatively: do not break your word.

statement: Let a hired worker eat from the crop he harvests
note: C1164-C1165 permit eating by hand with limits, for anyone entering; Maimonides applies it to hired workers.

statement: A hired worker must not take more than he eats
note: Saints/LXX swaps vv. 25-26: this vessel clause (Hebrew 23:25) is Saints 23:26, itemized by C1165, not C1164.

statement: A hired worker must not eat the crop while working
note: Saints/LXX swaps vv. 25-26: this sickle clause (Hebrew 23:26) is Saints 23:25, itemized by C1164, not C1165.

statement: Marry a wife by formal betrothal (kiddushin)
note: C1166 holds 24:1 but states the remarriage ban; no record directs marriage by betrothal or contract.

statement: Divorce only by giving a written bill of divorce
note: C1166 holds 24:1 but states the remarriage ban; S149 and K008/K012 discuss divorce, but none directs the written bill.

statement: Do not remarry your divorcee after she married another
note: C1166 itemizes it directly.

statement: A bridegroom stays home a year to gladden his wife
note: C1168 itemizes it directly.

statement: A bridegroom must not be conscripted or burdened for a year
note: C1167 itemizes it directly.

statement: Do not take food-preparing utensils such as millstones in pledge
note: C1169 itemizes it directly.

statement: Do not remove the signs of leprosy
note: C1170 says follow the priests' rulings; Maimonides reads 'take heed concerning leprosy' as barring removal of its signs, which no record states.

statement: Do not enter a debtor's house to seize a pledge
note: C1172 itemizes it directly.

statement: Do not keep a poor debtor's needed pledge overnight
note: C1174 itemizes it directly.

statement: Return the pledge to a poor debtor when he needs it
note: Itemized at Ex 22:25-26 (C0207); no record cites Deut 24:13, which only topical study S151 holds.

statement: Pay a hired worker's wages on the same day
note: C1175 itemizes it directly.

statement: Do not accept testimony from relatives
note: Maimonides reads 'fathers shall not die for children' as barring relatives' testimony; C1176 states the plain individual-responsibility rule.

statement: Do not take a pledge from a widow
note: C1177 itemizes it directly.

statement: Do not pervert the judgment of strangers or orphans
note: AUD-05-24-17 itemizes it directly.

statement: Leave the forgotten sheaf for the poor
note: C1178 forbids returning for the sheaf and names those for whom it is left.

statement: Do not go back to take a forgotten sheaf
note: C1178 itemizes it directly.

statement: Flog the guilty as the court prescribes
note: Judicial penalty filed as Instruction; comparable penalty rules (C1182, C1089, C1193) are Torah Law.

statement: Do not exceed the prescribed number of lashes
note: C1182 itemizes it directly.

statement: Do not muzzle an ox while it threshes
note: C1183 itemizes it directly.

statement: Marry the widow of a brother who died childless
note: C1185 itemizes the levirate duty; C1186 the naming of the child.

statement: The levirate widow must not marry an outsider
note: C1184 itemizes it directly.

statement: Perform the release (halitzah) when the brother refuses
note: Release ceremony split over C1187-C1191, all Instruction; a procedure, not a mislabel.

statement: Save the pursued, even by killing the pursuer
note: Maimonides derives a duty to rescue from 'cut off her hand'; C1193 states only the plain-sense penalty.

statement: Do not take pity on a pursuer
note: C1194 forbids sparing the punished offender; Maimonides applies 'your eye shall not spare' to stopping any pursuer.

statement: Do not possess inaccurate weights and measures
note: C1195 itemizes it directly.

statement: Remember what Amalek did to Israel
note: Filed as historical direction; comparable 'remember' charges (C1171) are Mosaic Command, so not a Law mislabel.

statement: Wipe out the descendants of Amalek
note: Standing judgment filed as historical direction while the parallel seven-nations judgment AUD-05-20-17 is Torah Law; arguably a one-time charge.

statement: Do not forget what Amalek did
note: Same historical record as P189; an exhortation, not a Law mislabel.

statement: Recite the declaration when bringing firstfruits
note: C1198 cites 26:5-10 as Additional Scripture; a ritual declaration, not a mislabel.

statement: Make the tithe declaration before God
note: C1202 itemizes it; a ritual declaration, not a mislabel.

statement: Do not eat second tithe while ritually unclean
note: C1202 is the declaration reciting these abstentions (Saints: 'for an unclean use'); no record states the prohibition itself.

statement: Do not eat second tithe while in mourning
note: C1202 is the declaration reciting this abstention; no record states the prohibition itself.

statement: Spend second-tithe redemption money only on food and drink
note: Only the declaration C1202 holds 26:14; C1033 (Deut 14:26) directs spending tithe silver on the sacred meal, not the prohibition.

statement: Walk in God's ways by imitating His attributes
note: No Torah record: Deut 8:6, 10:12, 11:22, 26:17 and 28:9 are uncited. Only Luke 6:36, Eph 5:1 and Gen 17:1 records.

statement: Assemble the people to hear the law every seventh year
note: Septennial assembly rite under Mosaic Instruction; not a mislabel.

statement: Every Israelite must write a Torah scroll
note: Catalogue treats 31:19 as Moses' one-time song commission; Maimonides derives a universal duty to write a Torah scroll.

statement: Do not drink wine poured as an idol libation
note: Poetic verse held only by a passage study and group; no record bars idol-libation wine. A111 (Acts 15:29) bars idol food among four abstentions.
